notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (Magento site, no WAF/challenge, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow - only generic User-Agent:* block on /account, /checkout, /wishlist). Counts: each category page shows Magento's native grid total ('Showing 1-20 of N products'), cross-verified against the breadcrumb count ('<Name> N products') and page title on the same fetch - all three matched for every category, so treated as exact (not a capped/rounded widget). Structure: site nav is a pure product-type tree (Chandeliers, Pendants, Wall>{Picture Lights,Spot Lights,Sconces}, Bath, Ceiling>{Flush Mount,Recessed}, Table, Floor, Outdoor>{Bollards,Gate Lights,Pole Lights,Wall Lights,Hanging Lights}) plus a 'Lamps' bulb tree and an 'Accessories' parts tree. Excluded per RULE: Lamps>{Filament Bulb,LED Bulbs,Incandescent} = light bulbs, not fixtures. Accessories>{Spares,Shades,Holders,Switches,Glass} = confirmed via product titles/JSON-LD to be lamp hardware and spare/replacement parts (nipples, cables, ball joints, sockets, E27/B22/E14 adapters, switches, fabric/glass replacement lampshades) - components, not standalone decorative fixtures, so excluded like bulbs/wiring hardware. '1Eva' (69 products) excluded as a brand/exclusive-collection listing page (NEVER EXTRACT rule). 'Clearance'/Sale excluded. Homepage room-tile links (/search?filter_suitable_for=Living|Bedroom|Dining Room|...) are a query-string facet over the sitewide /search index, not a separate room taxonomy - verified empirically: filter_suitable_for=Living alone returns 733 products (nearly the whole catalogue, far exceeding the ~830 total across the real type tree), confirming it is a facet re-cut, not a genuine curated room browse structure; excluded per Rule 0's facet carve-out (documented, not assumed from the room name). Rule 0 applied in FOS's favour: 'Bath' (vanity lights, actual fixtures) kept in scope despite the room-sounding name; Outdoor branch traversed in full with no depth limit. Mixed roll-up: 'Festive Lights' node (5 products) inspected by title - 4 are candle holders/stands (Midnight & Mustard tea light holder, Distressed Green cast-aluminium candle stand, Red wooden pillar candle stand, Swirling Sunset tea light holder) which are in-scope decorative accessories; 1 is an outdoor weatherproof string-light product (festive/holiday lighting, excluded). Extracted the 4 in-scope items as a manually-counted leaf under Decorative Accessories, dropped the string light, per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' rule. No duplicate-company signal found (distinct DTC lighting brand, foslighting.in).
